transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Ever since all the changes at work, I feel like I’m reacting badly to everything and I can’t adjust to the new setup no matter how hard I try. I ended up getting a referral through my company's employee assistance program because I'm having such a hard time coping with it all.
When did these changes at work occur, and how long have you been experiencing these difficulties?

The restructuring at my distribution center started about five months ago after a company merger. Within just a few weeks of those new systems and rotating shifts kicking in, I started feeling completely overwhelmed, and it's been going on consistently for about four months now.
Besides feeling overwhelmed by work, have you been experiencing a persistently low mood or a loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy?

Yes, I've completely stopped doing the things I used to enjoy, like playing in my rec league basketball games and visiting museums. I just feel way too overwhelmed to do any of that anymore. It feels like my whole life now just revolves around stressing about work.
Aside from feeling overwhelmed by work, would you say you feel sad, down, or empty most of the day, nearly every day, or is your low mood mainly tied directly to your work stress?

It's definitely tied directly to the work stress rather than being a constant, independent feeling of sadness. Right now, my whole life just revolves around stressing about work. I really think that if they would just stabilize the schedules and the new system, this feeling of being constantly thrown off would finally settle down.
Along with feeling overwhelmed and down, have you also been experiencing significant anxiety, worry, or nervousness?

Yes, I've been feeling really anxious and on edge. A minor shipping error or a last-minute schedule change can send me into this mix of panic and anger where I just want to walk out. I can't seem to get back to the steady, organized groove I used to have, no matter how hard I try.
How much have these feelings of anxiety and overwhelm interfered with your actual performance at work or your relationships with family and friends?

It's interfered a lot, especially at work where my accuracy has slipped so much that my supervisor pulled me aside, and I've even started calling out of shifts. In my personal life, I've completely stopped doing things like rec league basketball and museum visits. It feels like my entire life right now just revolves around stressing about my job.

latest_inference.note: The patient describes symptoms of both anxiety (feeling on edge, panic) and depression (loss of interest, feeling overwhelmed) that developed within weeks of a major work restructuring (stressor) five months ago. The symptoms are directly tied to this stressor and have caused significant occupational and social impairment, but do not meet the full criteria for a specific depressive or anxiety disorder. This presentation is highly characteristic of an adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood, so the candidate has been refined from F43.2 to F43.22.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with emotional and behavioral symptoms, primarily anxiety, worry, and feeling on edge, which developed within three months of an identifiable psychosocial stressor (workplace restructuring and rotating shifts following a company merger). The symptoms have persisted for approximately four months and cause significant functional impairment, including decreased work performance and withdrawal from social/recreational activities. While the patient reports some loss of interest in activities, the clinical picture is dominated by anxiety and tension, and the symptoms do not meet the full criteria for a major depressive episode or generalized anxiety disorder, pointing to Adjustment Disorder with Anxiety (F43.22).
